_doc: How each Uranium-original move and ability (uranium_id_map.json needs_engine) is generated into the engine by rpg2gba.battle_converter. Source of truth (CLAUDE.md 4.3). Moves: kind generate | alias | blocked. A generated move's effect comes from its Essentials function code (battle_converter/function_codes.py) unless the ruling gives effect/argument/additional_effects; anim names the stock move whose battle animation it borrows. Abilities: kind implemented (behaviour C in the engine, keyed on RPG2GBA_HAS_<ABILITY>) | inert (name and description only; reason says why). description: the text shown in game when Uranium's own does not fit the engine's box (moves: two lines, abilities: one); a short rewrite in Uranium's wording, so only where needed. Rulings decided 2026-10-19 (I3 S3).

PAYDAY.description:
A punch with a fist of gold.
Scatters coins to pick up.
PAYDAY.note: Displayed as Golden Fist: Uranium renamed and restatted Pay Day under its old internal name

SMOKESCREEN.note: Uranium's Smoke Screen is stock Smokescreen (Normal, 100 acc, 20 PP, accuracy -1); only the spelling differs

CORALBREAK.description:
Hits with waves of water.
Does physical damage.
CORALBREAK.note: Also an overworld field move in Uranium (breaks Coral events, Rock Smash badge); that half is transpiler work for the chapter that first meets coral

METALWHIP.description:
A sharp steel whip that
holds and hurts the foe.

SHUFFLE.note: Uranium gives it function 0D6 (Roost), whose effect replaces the hit: it heals the user by half and deals no damage. Generated as the status move it behaves as

SKYFALL.description:
Crushes the foe with air
pressure. May paralyze.

FLAMEIMPACT.description:
A blazing tackle heated by
air friction. Goes first.

SUBDUCTION.description:
A huge quake makes the land
rise and crash on the foe.
SUBDUCTION.note: Custom function 163: target Speed -2, then the user is confused

INSTANTCRUSH.description:
Crushes the foe with psychic
power. Always goes first.

GETLUCKY.description:
Psychic waves hit a weak
spot. Raises critical hits.

LASERPULSE.description:
A laser that cycles between
Fire, Electric and Ice.
LASERPULSE.note: Custom function 164: the move's type is rolled each use from Fire, Electric and Ice

GEMSTONEGLIMMER.description:
A blinding light from its
body. May lower accuracy.

OCEANSWRATH.description:
Traps foes in a giant
whirlpool for 4-5 turns.

CAUSTICBREATH.description:
Hurts the foe and lowers
its Defense and Sp. Def.
CAUSTICBREATH.note: Custom function 165: Defense and Sp. Def -1

THUNDERSTORM.reason: deferred: a new weather (damage every other turn, Ground/Electric immune); also needed by the Stormbringer ability

INFERNALBLADE.description:
A cursed-fire slash. Super
effective on Fairy. May burn.
INFERNALBLADE.note: Uranium special-cases it in pbTypeModifier: Fire against Fairy becomes super effective. Uranium's code multiplies by 4 (so 4x against pure Fairy); the engine effect gives the 2x its description promises

METALCRUNCHER.description:
Crunches with metal fangs.
Often lowers Defense.

DRAINLIFE.description:
Drains energy with fangs.
Heals half the damage dealt.

STICKYTERRAIN.reason: deferred: a new five-turn field effect that makes every priority move fail

machines._doc: The engine's TM/HM list (FOREACH_TM / FOREACH_HM) is generated from the game's own machine items. The engine needs each machine's move to be unique; a machine whose move another machine already teaches needs a placeholder here.

HM05.reason: Uranium's HM05 teaches Cut again (HM01's move) and no event gives it out; Flash, stock's HM05, is Uranium's TM70. Struggle is a move no Pokemon keeps, so the unobtainable HM05 teaches nothing

SHARPCORAL.note: User's Attack and Sp. Atk x2; its Defense and Sp. Def x0.5 when hit

LAZY.note: Falls asleep (3 turns) when it enters battle

REBUILD.description: Heals if not hit in a turn.
REBUILD.note: End of turn: heals 1/8 max HP if no move damaged it this turn

PETRIFY.note: On entry, lowers each foe's Speed one stage (Intimidate for Speed)

INFURIATE.note: Absorbs physical moves: the hit does nothing and Attack rises one stage (Sap Sipper's shape, for the physical category). Its own description undersells it; behaviour follows Uranium's pbTypeModMessages

ELEMENTALIST.note: Fire, Electric and Water moves get STAB (x1.5, x2 with Adaptability); does not stack with real STAB

ENERGIZATE.note: Normal moves become Electric with the -ate boost (Galvanize)

ACCELERATION.note: x1.5 to five moves Uranium lists by id: Extreme Speed, Fake Out, Quick Attack, Aqua Jet, Flame Impact

BLOODLUST.note: After attacking, heals 1/6 of the damage dealt

DEEPFREEZE.reason: Uranium itself never implements it (no script reads the ability); inert is faithful

STORMBRINGER.reason: deferred with the Thunderstorm weather it starts

QUICKCHARGE.note: +4 priority on the first turn after entering

SOUNDBOOST.note: x1.3 to eleven moves Uranium lists by id: Bug Buzz, Snarl, Chatter, Hyper Voice, Uproar, Relic Song, Round, Echoed Voice, Snore, Boomburst, Disarming Voice

NIGHTTERROR.note: A foe that wakes up while this Pokemon is on the field is paralysed
